notes: Page title 'Fries & Maagi', tagline 'Every kids favorite snack served with a twist'. Dark grey background with subtle gear/cog pattern; headings in yellow/gold decorative serif (Arabian-style display font), item names in bold yellow slab serif, descriptions in small white sans-serif, prices right-aligned in yellow with '/-' suffix. Green (veg) and red (non-veg) circle markers. 'Junktion77 - The Foodies' Crossroads' logo top right. Bottom: photo of cheesy loaded fries with bacon in a black bowl. No tax/charges note. Fully legible. 'French Fries with Tomato Salsa' price printed as '120-/-' (typo). Spellings as printed: 'Maagi', 'Noddles', 'Maggie', 'Arabita', 'tandgy', 'toped'. Toppings have no veg markers.
